newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Tobacco up on AIDS drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Japan Tobacco up on AIDS drug approval.

text.p: Japan Tobacco Inc (JT) shares jumped in early Monday morning trade after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration gave Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc, which has developed a retroviral therapy for HIV with JT, approval to market the drug, brokers said.
As of 0028 GMT, the shares were up 13,000 yen at 823,000.
Late last week, the FDA gave Agouron approval to market its HIV protease inhibitor Viracept in the United States.

Viracept was developed by Agouron in collaboration with the pharmaceutical division of Japan Tobacco Inc and is for use as a treatment for HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, when antiretroviral therapy is warranted.
